resources.string: Fetches history on demand per item and region. Always current, no storage required.
Downloads complete daily market history files from data.everef.net. Covers all items and regions. Data is ~3 days behind.
Universe data: types, market groups, regions, NPC stations. Downloaded from the official EVE Online SDE. Re-import to pick up NPC stations or new content.
Downloads the community citadel database from slysmoke/evernus-db. Enables name and system resolution for player-owned structures in orders, assets, and wallet.
No citadel data. Structures will show ID instead of name.
EVE's client can export your active orders and item order books to this folder. EventNight Trade Tools watches it and imports new exports automatically, bypassing ESI's cache delay.
Auto-detect couldn't find it — please Browse to it manually.
macOS path detection is best-effort and unverified — please confirm the folder manually.
Set the actual fees for each character. Used to calculate net profit in analysis.
Restart the app to apply the new language.

System-wide — they trigger even while the EVE client has focus. Click a binding, then press the combination you want (Ctrl/Alt/Shift + a letter or F1–F12, at least one modifier). Extra mouse buttons: bind them to this combination in your mouse software (Logitech G HUB, Razer Synapse, input-remapper on Linux).
Press Ctrl/Alt/Shift + a letter (A–Z) or F1–F12

Each character gets its own P2P Market identity automatically. The active one always follows whichever character you have selected in the app (even via a corporation) — export/import moves a key to another machine.

Serves a transparent, animated overlay page (session trades, profit, timer, relists) for OBS's Browser Source. Local only — nothing here is reachable off this machine.
